hooks.command: p=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty"); [ -n "$p" ] || exit 0; root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; case "$p" in /*) ;; *) p="$root/$p" ;; esac; case "$p" in "$root/.cursor/environment.json"|"$root/.claude/settings.local.json") exit 0 ;; "$root"/.claude/*|"$root"/.cursor/*|"$root"/.codex/*|"$root"/.agents/*) echo "BLOCKED: APM generates this file and overwrites it on the next pull. Edit the source in ai/.apm/ instead: rules in instructions/, skills in skills/, agents in agents/, hooks in hooks/." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0
